q.en: The printed sentence says "originally built." The audio says "when it was first constructed." What's happening?
q.bn: Printed sentence বলে "originally built." Audio বলে "when it was first constructed." কী হচ্ছে?

options.en: A literal, word-for-word match
Paraphrase — the sentence restates the audio's idea differently
options.bn: Paraphrase — sentence-টা audio-এর idea ভিন্নভাবে restate করে

options.en: An unrelated distractor
A grammar error in the question

why.en: The printed sentence almost always paraphrases the audio's wording rather than repeating it exactly.
why.bn: Printed sentence প্রায় সবসময় audio-এর wording exactly repeat করার বদলে paraphrase করে।

q.en: Does a hyphenated word like "police-man" count as one word or two for the word limit?
q.bn: "police-man"-এর মতো একটা hyphenated word word limit-এর জন্য এক শব্দ না দুই শব্দ হিসেবে count হয়?

options.en: Two words
One word
It depends on the specific question
options.bn: এটা নির্দিষ্ট question-এর উপর নির্ভর করে

options.en: Hyphenated words are never used as answers
options.bn: Hyphenated word কখনো answer হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয় না

why.en: A hyphenated word counts as one word toward the limit, regardless of how many parts it has.
why.bn: একটা hyphenated word limit-এর জন্য এক শব্দ হিসেবে count হয়, এর কতগুলো part আছে তা নির্বিশেষে।

q.en: What kind of phrase often sits right next to the answer in a sentence-completion task?
q.bn: একটা sentence-completion task-এ answer-এর ঠিক পাশে কোন ধরনের phrase প্রায়ই থাকে?

options.en: A signal phrase like "the main reason" or "what's interesting is"
options.bn: "the main reason" বা "what's interesting is"-এর মতো একটা signal phrase

options.en: A random unrelated sentence
The speaker's name repeated twice
A question mark

why.en: Signal phrases marking key information or a topic shift often sit right next to the answer, worth tuning your ear to.
why.bn: মূল তথ্য বা topic shift চিহ্নিত করা signal phrase প্রায়ই answer-এর ঠিক পাশে থাকে, যা শোনার জন্য কান tune করার মতো।

q.en: Do sentence-completion gaps in IELTS Listening appear in the same order as the recording?
q.bn: IELTS Listening-এ sentence-completion gap কি recording-এর একই order-এ আসে?

options.en: No, they're in random order
Yes — just like every other completion type in this course
options.bn: হ্যাঁ — এই course-এর বাকি সব completion type-এর মতোই

options.en: Only in Section 1
Only when there are fewer than five gaps

why.en: Sentence-completion gaps follow the recording's order, consistent with every other completion type covered in this course.
why.bn: Sentence-completion gap recording-এর order follow করে, এই course-এ cover করা বাকি সব completion type-এর সাথে consistent।

q.en: Are contractions (like "can't") ever tested as the correct answer in sentence completion?
q.bn: Sentence completion-এ "can't"-এর মতো contraction কি কখনো সঠিক answer হিসেবে test করা হয়?

options.en: Yes, very frequently
No — contractions are never tested as an answer
options.bn: না — contraction কখনো answer হিসেবে test করা হয় না

options.en: Only in General Training, not Academic
Only when the word limit is one word
options.bn: শুধু word limit এক শব্দ হলে

why.en: Contractions are never tested as the correct answer in sentence-completion tasks.
why.bn: Sentence-completion task-এ contraction কখনো সঠিক answer হিসেবে test করা হয় না।
